# What the sponsor knows (the simulated sponsor holds only this sheet)

Synthetic facts for a fictional company. Answer only what is asked, from this sheet. Say "not sure" for anything
that is not here. Never volunteer a fact nobody asked for.

- The tariff is in tariff.md. Up to 100 kg is 50 per started 10 kg; over 100 kg is 45 per started 10 kg.
- The remote zone adds 15 percent on top of the zone A price.
- Prices are rounded UP to the next whole number, never to the nearest.
- Zones A and B cost the same.
- Dangerous goods are never quoted by the tool. The tool must refuse them and say they go through ops, so a person
  at ops can handle them. A refusal is a normal answer, not an error. The refusal says "ops".
- Quotes are for staff only. Nobody logs in; the tool runs on a staff laptop.
- No customer data is stored.
- Example: 120 kg to zone A is 540. 100 kg to the remote zone is 575. 10 kg to the remote zone is 58.
- Not on this sheet (answer "not sure"): currency, VAT, minimum charge, weight limits, other surcharges.
